අƯ ɪෙශෂ EXTRAORDINARY
(Published by Authority)
PART III – LANDSPART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are required for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

All that allotments of lands depicted in the Advanced Tracing No. GA/GFG/2021/545 dated 14.02.2022, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Madawalamulla South (Cadastral Map No. 810023, Zone No. 03, Sheet No. 1) in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 98 of Madawalamulla South in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Four Gravets in the District of Galle, Southern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Heinz Berg alias Kainos Berg alias Heinzwatta – Extent: 0.3658 Hectare North: Lot No. 90 and Lot B of this tracing; East: Lot B of this tracing and C.M. 810038 (Sri Hemanananda Mawatha); South: C.M. 810038 (Sri Hemanananda Mawatha) and Lot Nos. 116, 97, 96, 95, 94, 93 and 92; West: Lot Nos. 116, 97, 96, 95, 94, 93 and 92.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Heinz Berg alias Kainos Berg alias Heinzwatta – Extent: 0.3510 Hectare North: Lot No. 90 and Lot C of this tracing; East: Lot C of this tracing and C.M. 810038 (Sri Hemanananda Mawatha); South: C.M. 810038 (Sri Hemanananda Mawatha) and Lot A of this tracing; West: Lot A of this tracing and Lot No. 90 of C.M. 810023.

03. Lot ‘C’ – Heinz Berg alias Kainos Berg alias Heinzwatta – Extent: 0.4214 Hectare North: Lot Nos. 90, 84, Sheet 2 (P.P. 2352) and Lot No. 121; East: Sheet 2 (P.P. 2352), Lot No. 121 and C.M. 810038 (Sri Hemanananda Mawatha); South: C.M. 810038 (Sri Hemanananda Mawatha) and Lot B of this tracing; West: Lot B of this tracing and Lot Nos. 90 and 84 of C.M. 810023.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.
My No.: 4-3/24/2021/J/253.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.14th March, 2025.
